summary_en: nixorokish added EIP-7851 (code controlled EOA delegation), EIP-8151 (ECDSA authority deactivation aware ecRecover), EIP-8131, EIP-7979 and others proposed at ACDE #238 to the Hegotá PFI list, and it was merged. EIP-8130 renamed verifier to authenticator and merged a round of clarifications. kassandraETH said the team is internally testing ERC-4337 relaying of Railgun withdrawals on mainnet. Starknet's STRK20 private assets went live.
